words.prose: {{ar:وَيْلٌۭ}} ({{tr:waylun}}) opens the surah as a compressed nominal verdict: ruin is made grammatically present before any actor, tense, buyer, seller, scale, or commodity is named. Its lexical force is not a neutral word for harm; it names doom and performs denunciation, while the lack of vocative or possessive lament markers keeps it from sounding like self-lament. The indefinite abstract noun leaves the ruin open-ended, and the omitted predicate makes the listener supply the relation as doom-for the coming class. This same threat word returns later in the surah (83:10), so the opening commercial charge is placed from the start inside the surah's wider denial-and-accountability register. Even the pacing matters only at the surface level: the short verdict lands first, then the longer target phrase stretches out the identification.

topics.headline: compressed nominal verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not narrate punishment happening; it states ruin as a standing verdict whose target will be supplied by the following phrase.
topics.reason: The QAC grammar and attachment evidence support an indefinite nominative abstract noun in a compressed nominal clause with an omitted existential predicate, so the CRITICAL claim about verdict-before-explanation is locally licensed.

topics.headline: doom word as uttered condemnation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first word both names the ruin assigned to the class and performs the condemnation by being uttered first.
topics.reason: V4 supports both doom and lament branches, but the local form lacks vocative and possessive lament markers, so the surviving payoff is outward doom-as-condemnation rather than self-including lament.

topics.headline: abstract noun rather than cry episode
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wording assigns an open-ended category of ruin, not one isolated cry, one narrated lamenting action, or one specified penalty.
topics.reason: The surface is an abstract noun, and the contextual profile treats the exact form as the stable corpus form; related verbal or instance forms remain lexical background rather than the local parse.

topics.headline: threat register with same-surah return
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that marginal under-measuring is introduced in the same threat register that later names denial in the surah (83:10).
topics.reason: The exact abstract noun is well attested in threat formulas, and the same surah repeats the form at 83:10, supporting a local arc without turning the distributional profile into a new sense.

topics.headline: verdict first, target after
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the order of experience: the verdict strikes first, and only then does the target phrase identify who carries it.
topics.reason: First-word placement and nominal compression are secure; the sound and cadence observations are kept as surface pacing rather than proof of lexical meaning.

words.prose: {{ar:لِّ}} ({{tr:li}}) is small, but it performs the transfer from verdict to target. It governs the following genitive class and makes {{ar:وَيْلٌۭ}} ({{tr:waylun}}) an assigned adverse outcome rather than a floating curse. Its middle position also matters: the listener has already heard the threat, and this particle pivots the clause toward the named recipients. Because the prefixed {{ar:ل}} ({{tr:lām}}) fuses in recitation with the following article, the grammar of assignment is heard as a tight boundary join in {{ar:لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ}} ({{tr:lil-muṭaffifīna}}).

topics.headline: adverse assignment to the class

topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence both mark the particle as governing the following genitive phrase, which supports the CRITICAL reading of assigned adverse entitlement.

topics.headline: hinge after the verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle is the hinge where an already-heard verdict becomes accountable speech aimed at named people.
topics.reason: The particle stands between the doom noun and the class noun, so the structural claim about a pivot from verdict to target is directly supported by local word order.

topics.headline: bound sound-boundary fusion

topics.reason: The prefixed preposition and the following definite article form a tight surface sequence, so the liaison topic survives as audible support for the already licensed syntactic dependency.

words.prose: {{ar:لْمُطَفِّفِينَ}} ({{tr:l-muṭaffifīna}}) is not a generic fraud label. It is a definite plural active participle, so repeated conduct becomes the name of a recognizable class, while each member remains a responsible doer. Under the preceding preposition, this class is the recipient of the adverse assignment, not the instrument, commodity, or background marketplace scene. The selected root branch is shorting measure or balance: the word names agents who make another person's due amount deficient. The broader {{ar:ط ف ف}} ({{tr:ṭ-f-f}}) field of slightness, brim, and edge helps the reader feel why tiny reductions matter, but local form and sequel keep the sense on engineered short-measuring, not mere smallness or edge-approach. The word withholds buyer, seller, object, scale, and commodity in 83:1; the rare class-name is then unpacked by the measuring and weighing clauses in 83:2-3. It also condenses the violation of the full-measure and straight-weighing command field (26:181-183). Its closure position makes the class itself the landing point of the opening verdict, and the surface tightening of the doubled consonant can underscore fine repeated trimming without serving as proof of meaning.

topics.headline: recognized plural agent-class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah targets a recognizable class of repeated doers, not an abstract practice, a hypothetical offender, or one isolated individual.
topics.reason: The definite masculine sound plural active participle is substantivized in the clause, supporting a class-wide target made up of responsible agents.

topics.headline: recipient of adverse allocation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the class is syntactically made the recipient of the doom assignment, not the instrument, commodity, or background marketplace scene.
topics.reason: The preceding preposition governs this genitive plural, and attachment evidence marks the phrase as the complement that completes the threat's target.

topics.headline: tiny margin made morally visible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the offense at the edge of perception: a slight quantitative reduction becomes the very mechanism of moral liability.
topics.reason: V4 supports slightness, brim or edge, and short-measuring branches; local form and context select short-measuring while the smallness and margin imagery remain as narrowing color, not independent local senses.

topics.headline: caused deficiency by agents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the deficiency is produced by agents; it is not accidental scarcity or a deficient object simply being described.
topics.reason: The local word is an active participle tied to the Form II short-measuring field, so broader states such as mere scantness or edge-approach must be narrowed to caused reduction imposed by doers.

topics.headline: rare label defined by sequel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah names the class before displaying the commercial mechanics, so 83:2-3 functions as the label's immediate explanation.
topics.reason: The contextual profile marks this root-form as a single occurrence, and the next ayahs supply the measuring and weighing behavior, so the forward-definition topic is strongly local.

topics.headline: violated full-measure ethic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the class-name condenses the opposite of the full-measure and straight-weighing command field (26:181-183).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide a concrete cross-reference to 26:181-183, and the local short-measuring branch coheres with that contrast without letting the external passage govern the local parse.

topics.headline: class-name as landing point
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening clause lands on the social identity itself after the verdict has already sounded.
topics.reason: The word closes the three-word clause, and its definite plural form supports the CRITICAL claim that the social class becomes the take-away of the opening verdict.

topics.headline: surface texture of fine trimming
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a surface texture that can make fine repeated trimming perceptible, while meaning remains grounded in morphology and lexical evidence.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Condemnation of engineered marginality.** `ط ف ف` B003 is shorting measure or balance; B001 is smallness or a trifling thing. The following ayat supply the structural asymmetry: fullness is demanded when receiving (83:2), but deficiency is produced when giving (83:3). I assign B003 the commercial action and B001 the offender's implicit minimization of each shortfall. The abductive arrow is mine: repeated “trifles” become a system precisely because each loss can be dismissed as negligible. The ayah changes from naming isolated cheats to naming agents who weaponize the margin.

2. **A brim deliberately not reached.** `ط ف ف` B002 supplies the measure's brim and near-fullness, while B003 supplies shorting. The adjacency of `يَسْتَوْفُونَ` in 83:2 activates the contrast between being near full and insisting on complete fullness. I infer that control of the last increment is the operative lever. The warning thus targets manipulation at the boundary where “almost full” is presented as full.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The final `ثُوِّبَ` (83:36) unexpectedly made the tiny withheld margin structurally large: the act travels back to its maker, so “trifling” loss becomes a return circuit.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A crime committed at the brim.** Lexical evidence: ط ف ف/B002, "the measure's brim and near-fullness," and ط ف ف/B003, "shorting the measure and balance," in ٱلْمُطَفِّفِينَ. Structural cue: 83:2 supplies their own complete taking through و ف ي/B001, while 83:3 supplies their measuring, weighing, and imposed deficiency. Assigned role: B002 locates the manipulation at the threshold of fullness; B003 names its direction against the recipient. Abductive move: I infer that near-fullness is operationally useful because it lets a deficit masquerade as completion; the packet gives the brim/fullness opposition but not that motive. Reading change: the noun identifies specialists in exploiting the almost-full boundary, not simply people who make an unspecified reduction.

2. **Trivialization placed against magnitude.** Lexical evidence: ط ف ف/B001, "smallness and a trifling thing." Structural cue: the slight amount in 83:1 is followed by being roused (83:4; ب ع ث/B001) for a great occasion (83:5; ي و م/B003 and ع ظ م/B001/B004) on which people stand (83:6). Assigned role: B001 explains the offenders' likely moral minimization; the later magnitude reverses that scale. Abductive move: I infer a psychology of treating a small shortage as uncountable; only smallness and the great-day contrast are explicit. Reading change: the warning falls not only on the amount removed but on the evaluative habit that calls repeated small harms trivial.

3. **An asymmetry that cannot stand in the final assembly.** Lexical evidence: ط ف ف/B003 in the fixed noun. Structural cue: the reciprocal transaction of 83:2-3 places full acquisition and imposed loss on opposite sides, while 83:6 makes the same ٱلنَّاس who were transaction partners stand together. Assigned role: deficient measure is the local mechanism that destabilizes a common social field. Abductive move: I infer that collective standing removes the positional privilege of buyer versus seller; the packet supplies the role reversal and later common stance. Reading change: ٱلْمُطَفِّفِينَ reads as makers of a two-tier human order that the window immediately levels.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 83:6 was the decisive later surprise: the same human field that had been split into advantaged and disadvantaged transaction roles becomes one standing collective. That correction made ط ف ف/B003 read as damage to social levelness, not only to quantity.

findings.text: Suç, ölçünün tamlık sınırında işlenir: tama çok yakın olan miktar, eksikliği tamamlanmış gibi göstermenin aracına dönüşür.
Küçük görülen her kayıp yinelendikçe bir düzene dönüşür; büyük gün ve son karşılık bu önemsizleştirme ölçüsünü tersine çevirir.
Eksik verme, insanları alan ve kaybeden taraflar olarak iki ayrı düzeye böler; herkesin birlikte ayağa kalkması bu ayrıcalıklı konumları düzler.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: Moral Boundary, Repair, and Returned Judgment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Conduct is measured by whether it preserves or crosses a moral limit, then returns to the actor as blame, repair, or recompense.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same cycle extends backward to delay before good and forward to confession, renunciation, and expiation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Recompense Returning to Its Source
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A deed reaches its outcome, returns to its doer as payment, and fixes the final moral condition.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: recompense returning to the worker `ث و ب:B002/m01`; reckoning and requital `د ي ن:B002/m01`; return to final outcome `ء و ل:B002/m01`; reversal and return `ق ل ب:B005/m01`; falling into ruin `و ي ل:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Recompense is figured as a return rather than an external addition. The deed travels toward its end, turns back upon its source, and resolves either as due payment or ruin.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Goods, values, and obligations are made commensurable so that transfer can be completed without hidden shortfall.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Physical measure opens into market demand, pricing, debt, cash, surety, and delegated equivalence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Fair Measure Against Concealed Shortfall
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A quantity is measured, checked against justice, and either delivered in full or reduced to another party's loss.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: deficient measure `ط ف ف:B003/m01`; measuring food `ك ي ل:B001/m01`; loss through measure and weight `خ س ر:B003/m01`; just balance `و ز ن:B002/m01`; completion without deficiency `و ف ي:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The measuring instrument mediates between the parties. Justice requires that the measured amount and the delivered amount coincide; any hidden reduction converts exchange into injury.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Goods, values, and obligations are made commensurable so that transfer can be completed without hidden shortfall.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Physical measure opens into market demand, pricing, debt, cash, surety, and delegated equivalence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Brim, Fullness, and the Last Increment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A vessel or quantity approaches its rim, is compared with a nearby amount, and passes from near-full to complete.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: the rim of a measure `ط ف ف:B002/m01`; overflowing fullness `ض ح ك:B008/m01`; approximation in amount `ق ر ب:B016/m01`; encompassing totality `ك ل ل:B003/m01`; complete fulfillment `و ف ي:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: These motifs isolate the boundary at which a small increment matters. The brim marks a measurable threshold, approximation brings the amount close, and fulfillment removes the residual gap.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Social judgment is enacted through covert gesture, laughter, fault-finding, shame, and eventual reversal of who observes whom.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The scene extends from a private eyelid signal to public reputation, bodily expression, shamelessness, and returned humiliation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Returned Derision and Disgrace
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The social direction of mockery reverses, and the former observers become the object of laughter and public disgrace.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: reversal of position `ق ل ب:B004/m01`; recompense returned to the actor `ث و ب:B002/m01`; object of laughter `ض ح ك:B002/m01`; lament of disgrace `و ي ل:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Reversal changes the direction of the gaze, recompense changes the ownership of the act, and laughter exposes those who had treated exposure as their privilege.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: Living Body, Reproduction, Injury, and Recovery
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Life is embodied through breath, organs, bodily proportion, reproduction, vulnerability, and restoration.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The body channel includes diaphragm, pelvis, lip cleft, mustache and throat, lochia, afterbirth, animal presentation, nausea, heart injury, and medicinal repair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Viscera, Flank, and Soft Abdominal Tissue
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The abdomen is mapped through entrails, diaphragm, flank, and loose external tissue.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: intestines `م ر ر:B008/m01`; loose abdominal flesh `ط ف ف:B008/m01`; inner diaphragm `ح ج ب:B004/m01`; flank and waist `ق ر ب:B015/m01`; rendered body fat `ء ه ل:B006/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The diaphragm marks the upper interior, entrails occupy the visceral center, flank locates the side wall, and loose tissue and fat describe the abdomen's outer material.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Places become inhabitable and navigable through residence, landmark, elevation, boundary, direction, and path.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Lexical place-making spans a settled city, named mountains and valleys, hot remote steppe, basalt ground, shore edge, overlook, and clear road.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Edge, Side, Shore, and Overlook
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An observer reaches a boundary, takes a side position, and looks down or across from an elevated edge.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: shore or projecting edge `ط ف ف:B004/m01`; object's rim or border `ح ج ب:B007/m01`; opposite side or bank `ع د و:B009/m01`; high overlook `و ف ي:B003/m01`; direction or facing side `و ج ه:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The border defines where one surface ends, the side locates the observer relative to it, and elevation converts the boundary into an overlook.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: Fire, Heat, Anger, and Armed Conflict
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Heat intensifies from kindling to blaze and extends analogically into inflamed emotion and battle.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The fire complex includes ember hidden in soil, a fire drill, grinding stone, a face heated by anger, rear battle ranks, and remembered sacrilegious wars.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Blaze and Entry into Fire
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Fire intensifies into a fierce blaze and a person enters or meets its heat.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: fiercely blazing fire `ج ح م:B001/m01`; entering and suffering fire `ص ل ي:B003/m01`; engulfing cover `ك ف ر:B002/m01`; ruin as outcome `و ي ل:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Engulfment removes distance from the blaze, encounter turns heat into bodily experience, and ruin names the terminal state.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A person's ability to act is shaped by vigor, composure, fatigue, self-estimation, honor, and comfort.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Inner condition ranges from patient composure and alertness to helplessness, pride, conquest, bodily softness, and luminous well-being.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Fatigue, Helplessness, and Diminished Agency
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Capacity declines through dullness, fatigue, weakness, or smallness until action stalls.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: blunt fatigue `ك ل ل:B001/m01`; helpless weakness `ظ ن ن:B008/m01`; stopping through weariness `ق و م:B016/m01`; slightness or paucity `ط ف ف:B001/m01`; slackened effort `ء ل ي:B008/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Slight capacity reduces force, fatigue blunts continuation, and helplessness turns a temporary pause into inability to complete the act.

word_morpheme_spans.note: word_analysis critical words are orthographic/analytic units, not QAC words; each resolves to a MORPHEME SPAN. The upstream aligned_qac_word_ref is preserved verbatim in word_analysis and is NOT corrected here -- renumbering would fabricate identities (PRINCIPLES.md §11 / basmalah no-hidden-renumbering rule). Use word_morpheme_spans for any word-level join to QAC.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.note: aligned_qac_word_ref does NOT resolve against qac_morphemes for this ayah: word-analysis counts orthographic words where QAC counts morphological words. Word-level joins between word_analysis topics and QAC morphology are UNRELIABLE here. Upstream defect in quran-data's word-analysis; deliberately not auto-repaired (renumbering would fabricate identities).

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_focus_trace_hermetic.note: Hermetic Focus Trace not requested for this bundle. Rebuild with --include-focus-trace, or --require-focus-trace when reader JSON must be present.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.
